Title: Information on: How do I overpower the spiciness in a dish?...
To overpower the spiciness in a dish, several methods can be employed. Adding ingredients with cooling and dairy-based properties such as yogurt, cream, or milk can help balance out the heat. Alternatively, incorporating ingredients rich in acidity, like lemon juice or vinegar, can also counteract the spiciness. Lastly, adding sweet flavors, such as honey or sugar, can help reduce the perceived intensity of spicy dishes.
--- End Document 1 ---
